item.title: Deepseek Poem Review
item.description:
To start, Claude refused to process my blog, probably because it had the word Deepseek in it. Khair, Grammarly is better, will check its pro and ai features someday.

Mudda one, input to Deepseek my poem Chaos and requested it “Act as a literature teacher and review my poem.” pasting the result here with md formatting done by ChatGPT. The input the Deepseek were a month ago when it was much faster.

Review of Your Poem “Chaos”

Structure and Form

Your poem is structured in a way that mirrors the chaos it describes. The lines are free-flowing, with no strict meter or rhyme scheme, which effectively captures the disjointed and unpredictable nature of chaos. The lack of formal structure allows the reader to experience the poem in a more organic and immersive way, much like the chaos itself.

Imagery and Symbolism

The imagery in your poem is vivid and evocative. You use a variety of settings—from a “thought created dungeon” to a *“calm endless sea”—*to illustrate the internal and external landscapes of the speaker. The “shimmering reflection of this star-lit sky” and the “blurred vision of paper lanterns” create a sense of beauty and tranquility amidst the chaos, suggesting that even in disorder, there is a form of order or peace to be found.

The symbolism of the “ship” and the “oarsmen” rowing into the “abyss” is particularly powerful. The ship represents the speaker’s life, the oarsmen represent the voices or influences that guide them, and the abyss symbolizes the unknown or the challenges they face. This imagery suggests a journey through life, where the speaker is both a participant and an observer, navigating through the chaos.

Themes

The central theme of your poem is the coexistence of chaos and order, or perhaps the illusion of order within chaos. The speaker acknowledges the chaos around them but also finds a sense of calm and purpose in it. The line “Chaos never settles. It is we who will find a place” encapsulates this theme, suggesting that while chaos may be constant, it is up to us to create our own sense of stability and meaning.

Language and Tone

Your language is rich and poetic, with a mix of abstract and concrete imagery. The tone is contemplative and introspective, reflecting the speaker’s deep thought and self-awareness. The use of phrases like “thought created dungeon” and “life at its apex” adds a layer of philosophical depth to the poem, inviting the reader to ponder the nature of existence and the human experience.

Strengths

  • Imagery: The vivid and varied imagery effectively conveys the complexity of the speaker’s experience.
  • Symbolism: The use of symbols like the ship and the abyss adds depth and meaning to the poem.
  • Theme: The exploration of chaos and order is well-developed and thought-provoking.

Areas for Improvement

  • Clarity: While the abstract nature of the poem is part of its charm, some lines could benefit from a bit more clarity to ensure the reader fully grasps the intended meaning. For example, the line “Rowing voices of my oarsmen into the abyss” could be slightly rephrased for better readability.
  • Flow: The poem flows well, but there are moments where the transitions between images could be smoother. Consider how the images connect to each other to create a more cohesive narrative.

Overall

Your poem “Chaos” is a compelling exploration of the human experience in the face of disorder. The imagery is rich, the symbolism is powerful, and the theme is thought-provoking. With a bit more clarity and attention to flow, this poem could be even more impactful. Well done!

2nd prompt “in the same tone write me another poem espace”

Escape

In the vast expanse of espace, I wander, a solitary star.
A cosmic wanderer, adrift in the infinite dark.
My thoughts, like galaxies, spiral into the void,
Each one a nebula, a swirling mass of light and shadow.

I am the silent observer, the watcher of worlds,
A speck of consciousness in an ocean of time.
Here, in the espace of my mind,
I find solace in the silence, the endless night.

The universe whispers secrets to me,
Ancient tales of creation and destruction.
I listen, enraptured, as the stars sing their songs,
Their melodies echoing through the corridors of my soul.

In this espace, I am free, unbound by the constraints of reality.
I soar through the cosmos, a voyager of dreams,
Exploring the uncharted realms of imagination,
Where the impossible becomes possible, and the unknown is known.

Yet, even in this boundless espace,
I feel the pull of gravity, the weight of existence.
I am but a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time,
A transient spark in the eternal flame of the universe.

As I drift through the espace, I ponder my place,
A tiny fragment in the infinite expanse.
But in this vastness, I find my purpose,
To be a witness, a creator, a dreamer of dreams.

In the espace, I am home,
A cosmic traveler, a star in the night.
Here, in the silence and the dark,
I find my voice, my light, my truth.

Espace, the endless void,
The canvas of my soul, the stage of my dreams.
In this boundless realm, I am free,
A star adrift, a dreamer of the infinite.

3rd prompt escape as in break the psychological barrier.

Escape

In the labyrinth of my mind, I am trapped, a prisoner of thought.
Walls of doubt and fear enclose me, a fortress of shadows.
I pace the corridors, searching for an exit,
A way out of this maze, this endless loop of self-doubt.

The voices echo, a cacophony of condemnation,
Each one a dagger, piercing my fragile resolve.
I am suffocated by the weight of my own mind,
A burden too heavy, a cage too tight.

But in the depths of this despair, a flicker of hope ignites,
A spark of rebellion, a whisper of freedom.
I reach out, grasping at the threads of possibility,
A lifeline in the storm, a beacon in the dark.\

With each step, the walls begin to crumble,
The shadows recede, the voices grow faint.
I push forward, driven by the desire to escape,
To break free from the chains of my own making.

The light grows brighter, the path clearer,
A door appears, a portal to a new reality.
I hesitate, fear still gripping my heart,
But the spark within me blazes, a fire of determination.

With a deep breath, I step through the threshold,
Leaving behind the labyrinth, the fortress of shadows.
I am free, unbound by the constraints of my mind,
A traveler of new horizons, a seeker of truth.

In this newfound space, I find peace,
A sanctuary of self-discovery, a haven of clarity.
I am no longer a prisoner, but a pioneer,
Charting the unexplored territories of my soul.

Escape, the journey within,
The breaking of barriers, the liberation of the mind.
In this freedom, I find my strength,
A beacon of light, a testament to resilience.

Escape, the ultimate freedom,
The triumph of the spirit, the victory of the soul.
In this newfound space, I am whole,
A seeker of truth, a master of my fate.

item.title: Pulse
item.description:
In the rhythm of life, sometimes we need to pause and check our pulse - to see how far we’ve come and how much has changed. Today serves as one of those moments of reflection.

Earlier today, I helped a colleague set up a blog. While WordPress seemed like the obvious choice, we opted for Hugo - a simpler solution that matched their comfort level. This interaction sparked memories of my own blogging journey, reminding me how our choices evolve with time.

Speaking of evolution, I drafted a piece about my changing preferences in choosing places of worship - a reflection on how my perspectives have shifted over the past decade. Yet, upon review, I decided not to publish it, feeling it came across as too self-righteous. It’s interesting how our self-awareness grows alongside our experiences.

The last time I wrote a blog post about installing Linux, AI chatbots weren’t part of our daily reality. Now, they’re everywhere - even this very post is being crafted with Claude’s assistance. It’s a stark reminder of how rapidly our technological landscape transforms.

Four years hold countless stories, yet when faced with the blank page, the words don’t flow as easily as one might expect. Perhaps that’s why this pulse check is important - it’s not about capturing everything, but about acknowledging that we’re still here, still growing, still adapting to the ever-changing rhythms of life.

Sometimes, the simplest way to restart is just to check your pulse and confirm: yes, we’re still here, still learning, still evolving.

item.title: Coffee
item.description:
Hello,

Your uncanny faith in what we have, what developed along the way, to uncertainties ahead. Is most of my muse these days. I did not bring anything to the table, nothing beyond necessities. Yet you morphed whatever scrap we had, mold its concoction of an existence to a meaningful whole. You could have moved on, you could have ended it all, you can still just fade to a life of your own. Which is fine, I too will wither away, in parts, slowly, one shade at a time.

If only I could swim in your eyes, through those dark trenches that separate us. I will fight against the wind, shade you in all means. Just the thought of you brings all the colors back to life. Sharing a cup of coffee with you, now that is a story I would love to write.

thanks,
Hamdan

item.title: Puppeteer
item.description:
Puppets! He mutters, not free, in a monolog, while unpacking the stage. Our biase, our presupposition, our belief, he continued. Its a story, add a pinch of salt at will. You can not see my harness, am I at my own will? with a concerned look on his face, while he sets two of his characters on the stage. These were not elaborate, those puppets, yet distinguishable, a male and a female.

He gently placed the female one on miniature wooden chair in a corner, arranged her pale white dress. There were no harness on the female character almost as if he never wanted her to speak. The male, on the other hand, came to life the moment puppeteer took control of his dowel.

I know you would ask me why to leave me hanging in all this mist, man-puppet said while facing towards the left of the stage, where the woman puppet was seated. He continued, dare I say, it felt not good to calm what developed in you. Who am I fucking with! I did not see this coming nor could have changed things in any way.

I’d wish you birthday, maybe buy that watch, don’t know if you would like that, I don’t know if you hate the idea of wearing a watch, or loath leather stripes, or hate red, or like blue or it ain’t a watch if it got this and that. I don’t know if you like stripes or plaids or vibrant or soft. But I know you would say why not know me now. The thing is, it took me 14 years just to exchange these pleasantries, why take any step to derail this, then part of me complains, “stop fucking around you angry fickle”.

The puppeteer now staring endlessly at the non-existing crowd, a wave of depression hits him hard. He shrugs it off, lets do this, lets get it over with, he said, raining in all the energy he got, but master the male puppet said, why I am your canary, I got a name you know.

I will send you help, the master said, while showering few coins on the puppet.

Seriously? said the puppet, the male puppet, female puppet does not have a voice, remember.

These marionettes, they develop a life of their own, puppeteer explains.

Daniyal, you know this ails me to see you complaining, I have given you everything, everything you could imagine, said the Puppeteer. I wish you could stretch your imagination a bit, he continued.

Daniyal, the male puppet, smiling at his master, you know it is not possible.Master, you enlighten so much, why not give me a complete vision of these intricacies? Daniyal, almost pleading.

You know Daniyal, you are just too stoned for anything, said Maya, its everyone for themselves. Not entirely Master interrupted. Is that so, Maya questions with a raised eyebrow. Ok, he walked away with too much, replied Master somewhat concerned. If you had not used him as a puppet for so long … interrupts, the Master with a blink of an eye frees Danyal of all his harness. Go have fun.

Daniyal, more concerned for what has developed between him and his master, and now this. You know you wanted vision, you wanted to live, breathe on your own, create art, see what life holds for you beyond this. You just needed my blessings, so be it.

Maya bows down in respect, Daniyal still looking for answers. Maybe one day, Master replies, chiseling away a new character, now go on.

item.title: A Letter to Muse
item.description:
Dear Muse,

Stuck in an endless loop of writing this letter and deleting it. Every time with a slightly different meaning, the goal? I am not clear on that. I simply can not get a grip on this untangled mess. Few of those letters had our differences listed, few emotionally charged, few aggressive, some more apologetic than others. That is not all, they even had profound shit like the utilitarian conclusion and stoic viewpoints. I am fragmenting things here, though this letter is about putting them back together. Life, me, everything is not perfect, nor I am expecting you to be. Hope there is some forgiveness left for me, and for my stupid puppets and their rhymes. In any case, I will be waiting here, behind this screen.

thanks,
Hamdan

item.title: Chaos
item.description:
In the midst of chaos I reside, a distant observer to my own life.
I am on a thought created dungeon, this calm endless sea.
Rowing voices of my oarsmen into the abyss,
me expressionless, at the bow of this ship.
Staring at the shimmering reflection of this star lit sky.
Every time I close my eyes, deserts, mountains,
lush green planes, life at its apex, all that is unseen.
I guess its time for me to go, I need to sleep.
A blurred vision of paper lanterns takes a fragile lift.
Edge of this earth where stars are formed.
A new moon is being forged,
Sun waiting to take a plunge.
You are late, Let’s do this.
To a new day, dawn.
dusk, dark again.
Chaos never settles.
It is we who will find a place.

I have recycled this couple of times, I think some of the lines might be stolen, which I recently learned is ok, “found poetry”. Though I can not remember where I read them, so that.

item.title: Bootstrap
item.description:
Bootstrap

Links

Steps

  1. Created a git repo
  2. Check out blog project locally
git clone https://github.com/HamdanKhan/blog.git hamdan.blog
cd ..
hugo new site hamdan.blog --force

–force because we already created the blog folder from git clone.

  1. Added a theme
git submodule add https://github.com/cntrump/hugo-notepadium.git themes/hugo-notepadium

Theme is notepadium copy-paste its config.toml to project toml file.

  1. Created a disqus account, also setup https://hamdan-blog.disqus.com
  2. Config hamdan-blog as disqus shortcode in config.toml file.
  3. Folder summary, watch Mike Dane videos for details.

  1. Write the first post
